description: Wide-character printable test: every code point except controls, U+2028/U+2029, surrogates, U+FFF9..U+FFFB, U+xFFFE/U+xFFFF and values above U+10FFFF (iswprint)
notes: musl 1.2.5, iswprint (src/ctype/iswprint.c), with wint_t as uint32_t. Written by us from the function. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: two branches, six range or mask compares and a phi: 23 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
